sentences.text: Today we will talk about Chile.
Chile is a long, narrow, and beautiful country in South America.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Chile?
Chile is in South America.
It is next to Argentina, Bolivia, and Peru.
To the west, it touches the Pacific Ocean.
Chile is very long.
It stretches from the desert in the north to cold forests in the south.
What is the capital city of Chile?
The capital city is Santiago.
Santiago is in the center of the country near the Andes Mountains.
It has tall buildings, museums, parks, and busy streets.
It is the largest city in Chile.
Other important cities are Valparaiso, a colorful port city, Concepción, a cultural and university city, Punta Arenas in the far south near Antarctica.
How many people live in Chile?
About 19 million people live in Chile.
Most people live in the central part of the country near Santiago.
The north and far south have fewer people.
What language do people speak in Chile?
The official language is Spanish, but many people also speak English, especially in cities and schools.
Some indigenous people speak languages like Mapudungun, Quechua, and Aymara.
What is the weather like in Chile?
Chile has many climates because it is a very long country.
In the north, it is hot and dry.
This is the Atacama Desert.
In the center, the weather is mild with four seasons.
In the south, it is cool and rainy with forests and mountains.
In winter, you can even go skiing in the Andes.
What does Chile look like?

Chile has the Andes Mountains along its eastern border, the Pacific Ocean on the west, the Atacama Desert, the driest place on earth, lakes, volcanoes, and glaciers in the south, the famous Easter Island in the Pacific Ocean.
Chile has many kinds of landscapes in one country.
What animals live in Chile?
Chile has llamas, guanacos, and foxes, condors, eagles, and penguins, whales, dolphins, and seals in the ocean, flamingos in the north, and pumas in the mountains.
Nature is wild and beautiful in Chile.
What do people eat in Chile?
Chilean food is simple, fresh, and often made with seafood.
People eat fish, crab, and shrimp, beef, chicken, and pork, potatoes, rice, and bread, corn, beans, and vegetables.
Popular dishes, empanadas, baked pastry filled with meat, cheese, or seafood.
Pastel de choclo, corn pie with meat and egg.
Cazuela, soup with meat, corn, and potatoes.
Completo, a big hot dog with tomato, avocado, and mayonnaise.
What do people drink in Chile?
People drink water, tea, and coffee.
Fruit juice like peach or grape.
Mocon uesillo, a sweet drink with wheat and dried peach.
Adults may drink Chilean wine or pisco, a grape liquor.
Chile is famous for its high quality wine.
What is life like in Chile?
Life in Chile is modern, friendly, and varied.
People enjoy spending time with family, going to school or work, walking in the mountains or along the beach, watching football, soccer, the most popular sport, celebrating with music and dance.
What are some holidays and traditions?
Independence Day, September 18th with music, food, and dance.
Christmas and New Year Easter with church and chocolate.
Fiestas Patrías, national celebrations with traditional clothes and food.
Mapuche ceremonies, indigenous traditions in the South.
People dance the Cueca, the national dance of Chile.
Some fun facts about Chile.
The Andes Mountains are the second longest mountain range in the world.
Chile has over 2,000 volcanoes, some are active.
The Atacama Desert is so dry, some places have never had rain.
The flag is red, white, and blue with one star.
Easter Island belongs to Chile and has big stone statues called Moai.
Now you know many things about Chile.
You know where it is, what people eat, and how they live.
You learned about deserts, volcanoes, and delicious food.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Amili.
See you next time.
Goodbye, or as they say in Spanish.
Adios.
